root_cause.text: The `DOMAIN_NS(unmap_pages)` function in the generic IOMMU page table implementation passed the requested unmap length (`len`) instead of the actual unmapped size (`unmap.unmapped`) to `gather_range_pages`, resulting in incomplete TLB invalidation when an unmap operation extended into a large or contiguous IOPTE.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix IOTLB page gathering by using the actual unmapped size instead of the requested length.
intent_record.what: The fourth argument passed to the gather_range_pages function is changed from 'len' to 'unmap.unmapped'.
intent_record.how: This restricts the IOTLB page gathering operation to the range that was actually unmapped during the page table walk, preventing incorrect tracking of pages that were not unmapped.
